summary: Scoped structure cleanup split translation test fixtures, OCR runtime helpers, and Ollama model-pull logic. API Release tests pass; external validation remains.
active_objective: Resolve remaining external production validation blockers before release.
assumptions: Primary production target is Windows 10 1809 or newer / Windows 11 with PowerShell 7 for repository operations.
npm is the frontend package manager because package-lock.json is present.
The repository gate is the canonical local and CI readiness check.
decisions: Keep verification centered on scripts\Invoke-Gate.ps1 -Configuration Release.
Do not treat unsigned installer output as release-ready without signing and lifecycle evidence.
Keep generated build, dependency, test, and packaging outputs ignored rather than tracked.
current_tasks: Validate live Ollama offline/restart behavior, interrupted model pulls, and large-context failures with representative local models.
Validate long chat/layout behavior in the Windows WPF WebView shell at desktop and narrow widths.
Validate OCR GPU diagnostics and provisioning on representative CPU-only, NVIDIA-driver-missing, runtime-missing, and runtime-ready Windows machines.
Run signed installer lifecycle validation on a clean Windows verification machine.
Continue scoped oversized source and test file review; split remaining files only where responsibility boundaries are clear.
next_tasks: Run scripts\Invoke-Gate.ps1 -Configuration Release -IncludeInstaller on a machine with Inno Setup when installer packaging is in scope.
Run scripts\Test-InstallerRelease.ps1 -RequireSigned -RunInstallLifecycle against the signed installer candidate.
Capture external validation evidence for Ollama, WebView2 shell, OCR GPU states, and installer lifecycle.
blockers: Live Ollama validation requires a local Ollama instance plus disk/network capacity for representative model pulls.
NVIDIA/OCR validation requires representative Windows hardware or reliable mocked driver/runtime states.
Signed installer lifecycle validation requires Inno Setup, signtool, a trusted signing certificate, and a clean Windows verification machine.
risks: Release readiness still depends on external runtime validation that cannot be proven from this workspace alone.
Installer packaging and install/uninstall lifecycle were not executed in this audit pass.
Some source/test files still exceed review thresholds and increase maintenance risk until scoped cleanup is completed.
Qdrant remote endpoints without TLS or API key are allowed with warnings and must be limited to explicitly trusted networks.
structure_notes: Solution layout is coherent for a Windows WPF shell, in-process API, shared core contracts, infrastructure adapters, worker abstractions, Vite React UI, packaging, scripts, docs, and tests.
Generated outputs are ignored: artifacts, packaging\qdrant\payload, bin/obj, src\OnlyRag.Web\dist, node_modules, test-results, coverage, and Playwright reports.
A minimal test cleanup fix was applied so LocalJobWorkerService instances are disposed before temporary SQLite storage deletion.
DocumentTranslationJobHandlerTests fixtures, OCR runtime/process helpers, and Ollama model-pull logic were split into focused partial files without behavior changes.

external_services: Optional local or trusted-LAN Ollama endpoint

commands.test: dotnet test .\OnlyRag.sln --configuration Release --no-restore; Set-Location .\src\OnlyRag.Web; npm run test

last_completed_work: Split focused oversized C# test/source responsibilities and passed the OnlyRag.Api.Tests Release suite.
open_questions: Which machine will be used for signed installer lifecycle validation and external Ollama/OCR/WebView acceptance evidence?
handoff_notes: Use the canonical Release gate before handoff. Treat release as blocked until signed installer lifecycle and representative external runtime validations are recorded.
